name: Error-Guided Evidence Decomposition & Multi-Step Verification
hypothesis: Decomposing claims into sub-assertions and checking them against evidence guided by known error categories prevents abstention shift.
steps: Step 1: Sub-claim entity and predicate atomization
Step 2: Sentence-level evidence mapping and polarity assignment
Step 3: Error-targeted sanity check (addressing high-risk error modes)
